Author: Sandro
Name: NahjaUI
Punchline: A complete, modular interface for Final Fantasy XIV.
Description:
NahjaUI gives the game a clean, consistent interface that you build piece by piece. Switch on only what you want: everything else stays exactly as the game made it.

HUD bars: your parameter bar, target, target of target, focus target and party list.
Progress bars: your casts and your target's, with a slidecast marker, plus a global cooldown bar that shows the queue and weave windows.
Job gauges, status effects, nameplates and enmity list, each one with its own style.
Trackers: pick the enhancements, enfeeblements and cooldowns you want to see. Every job comes with ready-made presets.
Profiles: save, copy and share your whole setup.

Type /nui to open it.

Join the testers on Discord: https://nahjaui.github.io/discord
Changelog: New: Dancer job gauge. The four step pips show what you can press now (Cascade or Windmill, Fountain or Bladeshower, and the Silken procs), and in a dance only the step to do is lit, with the next one dimmed. New: Fan Dance III and IV auras. New: the Warrior Primal Rend, Primal Ruination and Primal Wrath auras are redrawn; Primal Wrath fades from right to left. Changed: all the auras now share one size and the same default place, including Freecure, Firestarter and Paradox. Changed: the Warrior preset keeps its gauge pieces in order under the Rotation row; Orogeny, Damnation and Bloodwhetting are no longer added as cooldowns, and the Warrior Rotation trackers come switched off. Changed: the raise icon in the party list is cropped and rounded like the tracker icons. Changed: your own HP bar is hidden while you are dead. Clean installs only: existing setups keep their positions and sizes.
